text:
Marta V.: Quick sync 9: Cloud Catalog Integration Launch Lab. Objective: 1) short co-auth blog (800-900 words), 2) 20-min partner podcast/live demo clip, 3) a tiny benchmark callout for the product page, 4) ensure catalog listing routes high-intent leads to reps. Target publish in 6 business days. Who can take which piece?

Theo P.: I can take the blog draft and coordinate partner quotes. Will aim for Wed EOD draft. Need product PR FAQ and a partner blurb (1-2 lines).

Sumi K.: I'll run the micro-benchmarks and produce a one-paragraph takeaway + simple metric table we can paste into blog and catalog. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Carlos D.: I'll handle the podcast recording + the 2-min demo clip. Can we keep the demo to "fast cold-start + token-cost example"? Need staging access.

Reece B.: I'll set up the marketplace listing metadata and lead routing. Proposal: tag leads `source=cloud_catalog` and `campaign=launch-lab-2025`. We'll create a HubSpot workflow to assign to catalog_inbound queue.

Marta V.: Good. For comms: social + partners email on publish day, short FAQ snippet in marketing assets. Also please use utm_source=cloud_catalog utm_campaign=launch-lab-2025 in all links.

Sumi K.: Bench run completed: median cold-start 135ms on our config, cost per 1k tokens ~0.28 USD after batching. I'll attach CSV to product channel. Keep numbers conservative.

Theo P.: Blog outline: problem -> integrator pain points -> Redwood+partner solution -> benchmark snapshot -> how to try it (catalog CTA + demo clip). Will include partner Q&A 3 bullets.

Carlos D.: Booked recording with partner for Thurs 11am PT. Will capture short demo and then edit to 2 clips: 90s demo + 60s testimonial.

Reece B.: HubSpot mapping snippet I'll implement: 
```
if lead.properties.source == "cloud_catalog":
  lead.owner = "sdr_catalog_inbound"
  lead.properties.tags += ["catalog","launch-lab-2025","partner-integrations"]
  lead.properties.priority = "high"
```
Will set test lead flow after hooks are deployed.

MarketplaceBot: Reminder: Catalog metadata schema validation scheduled in 12h. Missing fields: support_url.

Marta V.: Added support_url to docs. Theo, once draft is in I'll loop partner PM for quote sign-off.

Theo P.: Draft posted: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/launch-lab-blog. Need quick partner approval (one-line).

Sumi K.: Pushing bench summary to product channel. Quick table for blog: 
```
- cold_start_p50: 135ms
- tokens_per_sec_peak: 1200
- relative_token_cost: -27% vs baseline
```

Carlos D.: Demo GIFs uploaded to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/assets/launch-lab/gif1.gif

Reece B.: Test lead created and routed. Verified properties: `source=cloud_catalog`, `campaign=launch-lab-2025`, `owner=sdr_catalog_inbound`. HubSpot automation green.

Marta V.: Action list: Theo (blog final + partner one-liner), Sumi (Final bench blurb + alt copy), Carlos (final clips + SRT transcript), Reece (publish hooks + test lead verification). Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.

Theo P.: :white_check_mark: Partner approved quote: "Redwood's deployment in Aurora made integrating our embeddings trivial."

Sumi K.: :white_check_mark: Bench blurb ready, posted in docs.

Carlos D.: :white_check_mark: Clips edited and transcripts attached.

Reece B.: :white_check_mark: Hooks live. Also added a short lead qualification note for SDRs: 
```
If product = inference: ask about latency SLOs and data residency. Offer 20-min technical review + pilot credits.
```

Marta V.: Publishing now. Blog + catalog listing + clips go live in 10m. I'll send partner email and socials once live.

MarketplaceBot: Catalog item published (item_id=cc-2025-77). Preview: https://catalog.aurora.cloud/items/cc-2025-77

Marta V.: Promo posted. Thanks team 389 We'll check dashboard next week for traffic and lead conversions. Postmortem in 7 days.

Theo P.: Great work everyone.

Carlos D.: Nice one :clap:

Reece B.: Will monitor leads and report daily for first 3 days.
